title: On Complaining about the noise all winter
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：complain　|　正文 361 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 complain 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the baker ① complained about the noise all winter for the whole place, and every customer in the bakery said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the baker ② complains about the noise all winter without a word of thanks without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ complain about the noise all winter at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ complained about the noise all winter before — a line in the bill for December 1955 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Complaining about the noise all winter for the whole place, the baker said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the tray at the far oven, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ complain of a pain in the chest without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Complain of a pain in the chest at once and never mention it again.

By 1968 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the bill, and a new customer from the next bakery ⑧ complains of a pain in the chest for the whole place every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the oven, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ complained about the noise all winter again when nobody else would.

⑩ To complain about the noise all winter, my mother said in 1973, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the bakery remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the bakery forgets, somebody complains about the noise all winter without a word of thanks again and somebody must complain about the noise all winter for the whole place all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 抱怨（一般过去式 complained about the noise all winter：1961 年面点师头一回这样做，替所有人）
B. v. 抱怨（一般现在 complains about the noise all winter：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 抱怨（不定式 to complain about the noise all winter：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 抱怨（过去完成时 had complained about the noise all winter：1955 年十二月的账单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 抱怨（动名词 complaining about the noise all winter 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 诉说（complain of a pain in the chest：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去诉说诉说胸口疼）
G. v. 诉说（complain of a pain in the chest：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 抱怨（后段两处：新来的顾客照例 complains of a pain in the chest，而母亲又一次 complained about the noise all winter）

answers.why: complain 意为“抱怨”，1961 年面点师替所有人抱怨整整一冬抱怨吵闹，那是糕饼铺里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 complained。
complain 意为“抱怨”，自那以后面点师不图一句谢把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 complains。
complain 意为“抱怨”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯抱怨整整一冬抱怨吵闹”，此处为不定式 to complain about the noise all winter。
complain 意为“抱怨”，账单里 十二月 那行字说明早在 1968 年之前就有人抱怨过，故用过去完成时 had complained。
complain 意为“抱怨”，面点师说“抱怨整整一冬抱怨吵闹这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 complaining about the noise all winter 作主语。
complain 意为“诉说”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去诉说诉说胸口疼”，should ever 之后用原形 complain of a pain in the chest。
complain 意为“诉说”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻诉说诉说胸口疼（complain of a pain in the chest at once），以后再也不要提起。
complain 意为“抱怨”，新来的顾客每个星期都照例诉说诉说胸口疼，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 complains。
complain 意为“抱怨”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次替所有人抱怨整整一冬抱怨吵闹，用一般过去式 complained 叙述。
complain 意为“抱怨”，结尾那句是母亲 1973 年的话：要抱怨整整一冬抱怨吵闹，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和糕饼铺记住的那一件。

answers: In 1961 the baker complained about the noise all winter for the whole place, and every customer in the bakery said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three weeks on, the baker still complains about the noise all winter without a word of thanks without being asked.
My mother said later that to complain about the noise all winter at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had complained about the noise all winter long before 1968, and the line in the bill for December proves it.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 complain 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1961 the baker complained about the noise all winter for the whole place, and nobody in the bakery forgot it.
Even now the baker complains about the noise all winter without a word of thanks whenever the bakery asks.
Complaining about the noise all winter for the whole place, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever complain of a pain in the chest without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new customer from the next bakery complains of a pain in the chest for the whole place every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother complained about the noise all winter again, and the bakery remembered that half.
